subject: general
question: 'Resolved: Uniting Nations in a Divided World' is a memoir of who among the following former UN Secretary Generals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ban Ki-Moon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Former United Nations Secretary-General Ban-Ki-moon's **autobiography is titled** "Resolved: Uniting Nations in a Divided World."**
 
• It includes the author's life experiences and obstacles, as well as details of his time at the United Nations (UN).
 
• He served as the **eighth Secretary-General **of the United Nations from **January 2007 to December 2016**. Ban-Ki-moon goes on to tell how he went from being a "child of war" to becoming a** "man of peace"** in his book** 'Resolved: Uniting Nations in a Divided World,' **published by HarperCollins India.
 
• Former UN Secretary-General Ban-Ki-moon's first diplomatic assignment was in India, where he formed such a strong bond that he still tells the Indian people that half of his "heart belongs in their nation" 50 years later.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Boutros Boutros-Ghali **was an Egyptian politician and diplomat who led the United Nations as its sixth Secretary-General from 1992 to 1996.
 
• **Kofi Atta Annan** was a Ghanaian diplomat who served as the United Nations (UN) seventh Secretary-General from 1997 to 2006.
 
• From 1982 to 1991, Peruvian diplomat and politician **Javier Pérez de Cuéllar** served as the United Nations' fifth Secretary-General.
